source_scope.title: Uncovering the mode of action of engineered T cells in patient cancer organoids
source_scope.facts: The reference behavior atlas uses TEG tracks. ROR1 CAR T-cell comparisons are identified separately. Analysis combines speed, displacement, contact and death-channel observables; the 3.3 h track segments are analysis windows. S-BIAD448 is described as imaging data for the behavioral reference map; the paper links the BEHAV3D code repository.
source_scope.implication: A reference-map repository identifier alone does not establish a matched CAR-T movement dataset. No CAR-only trajectories or physical migration-speed distribution have been extracted here. The analysis-window duration is not a persistence parameter; normalized feature heatmaps do not calibrate 1 um/min, 5 min persistence or 0.5 directional bias.

source_scope.title: TNF-α synergises with IFN-γ to induce caspase-8-JAK1/2-STAT1-dependent death of intestinal epithelial cells
source_scope.facts: Combined cytokine response occurs in tested human colonic lines and organoids, with exceptions: HCA-7/RKO resist and LoVo is primarily IFN-gamma-sensitive. HT-29 viability/caspase observations include 24/48 h and a 72 h endpoint; some organoid observations occur at 8 h. Reported signaling persistence at 12-16 h is a different observable. The study separates marker activation from causal death-pathway assignment.
source_scope.implication: Supports context-dependent combined-response structure. Does not measure our irreversible priming rate, normalized thresholds, two-stage lag, saturated hazard, universal competence or cytokine diffusivity. No numeric import, curve digitization or fit. The 8 h organoid context must not be pooled with delayed cell-line observations into a universal timescale.

sources.title: Quantifying persistence in the T‐cell signaling network using an optically controllable antigen receptor

primary_findings.finding: In Jurkat-derived OptoCAR cells, calcium signal half-decay was 29 s (95% CI 27.4-30.5 s), estimated from a gamma survival fit.
The ppERK half-decay was 3.0 min (95% CI 2.4-3.6 min).
Active FOS half-decay was 3.1 min (95% CI 0.7-5.5 min).
The reported mRNA decay half-times were approximately 15-30 min. These are different observables from intracellular phosphorylation and extracellular protein secretion.

sources.applicability: These measurements do not identify the model damage-history state or calibrate a shared CAR-T cytokine source law. The primary-cell confirmation has a distinct readout.
